newsitem.title: USA: Donaldson FY96 year-end backlogs drop.
newsitem.headline: Donaldson FY96 year-end backlogs drop.

text.p: Donaldson Co Inc said Monday its total backlogs of $203.3 million at the end of fiscal 1996 were down about five percent from a year ago.
Donaldson, which makes filtration products, said the backlogs also were down about three percent from the end of the fiscal third quarter.
Hard-order backlogs, consisting of good scheduled for delivery in 90 days, amounted to $121.9 million, down nine percent from the end of fiscal 1995 and down three percent from the third quarter.
The current backlogs were affected by the gas turbine buisness, which typically shows wide swings in order patterns and shipments from quarter to quarter, Donaldson said.
